title: Pin codex to o4-mini in the reviewer agent list
summary: The repository's own osf.toml now names an explicit model for the codex reviewer instead of letting it fall back to its built-in default, which returned 401 against the review environment's API key. The reviewers test that asserts the parsed agent-to-model map is updated in lockstep, so the config and the expectation that guards it move together.

nodes.label: osf.toml
nodes.subtitle: reviewers + [agents.models]
nodes.summary: Declares the ordered reviewer list (codex, claude, opencode) and a model per agent. This change adds an explicit codex entry so the codex reviewer no longer falls back to its own default model.

nodes.label: [agents.models]
nodes.subtitle: agent name -> model id
nodes.summary: The table mapping each agent to the model it should be invoked with. An agent left out of this table uses its own default; codex was previously left out and now is not.

nodes.label: reviewers
nodes.subtitle: ["codex", "claude", "opencode"]
nodes.summary: The ordered list of agents that review a change. Unchanged by this diff, but it is the reason the codex model entry matters: codex is first in the order.

nodes.label: osf.toml parser
nodes.subtitle: reads reviewers and agent models
nodes.summary: The osf crate code that loads osf.toml and exposes the reviewer list and the per-agent model lookup. It is the consumer of both changed lines and is not itself modified.

nodes.label: reviewers.rs
nodes.subtitle: this_repositorys_osf_toml_selects_its_reviewers...
nodes.summary: Integration test that parses the repository's own osf.toml and asserts the resulting agent-to-model map. Its codex expectation flips from None to Some("o4-mini"), matching the new config entry.

nodes.label: codex agent
nodes.subtitle: invoked with the configured model
nodes.summary: The codex CLI that performs a review. It receives the model named in osf.toml; before this change it received no model flag and used its own default.

nodes.label: claude agent
nodes.subtitle: claude-sonnet-5
nodes.summary: The claude reviewer, already pinned to an explicit model. Included as context: it shows the pattern the codex entry now follows.

nodes.label: opencode agent
nodes.subtitle: openrouter/qwen/qwen3-coder-next
nodes.summary: The opencode reviewer, already pinned to an explicit model. Included as context for the same pattern.

nodes.label: review API key
nodes.subtitle: environment credential
nodes.summary: The credential the review environment supplies to the agent CLIs. The codex default model was rejected by this key with a 401, which is the reason for the change.
